neighbours.label: a connective opening a contrasting or following clause: ', but', ', so', ', while', 'Meanwhile,'
fire: Each cell has two copies, so we have two of each.
It is lighter. Meanwhile, others are heavier.
All are based on proteins, but all have a zinc ion.
Many are small, while others are large.
It was cheap, so we bought it.
It rained. Meanwhile, the crew kept working.
The first is easy, but the second is hard.
quiet: Each cell has two copies of each.
It is lighter than the others.
All are based on proteins with a zinc ion.
It rained on the crew at work.
The first is easy to read.

notes: The output direction promotes ' it', ' you', ' we', ' there' on the + pole. Probes: 0.33-0.42, but a final full stop reached 0.33, so this may not separate.
